evidence.title: Cognitive Profiling of LRMs' Reasoning Traces Using Bloom's Taxonomy

summary: A team of AI researchers analyzed the step‑by‑step reasoning traces of large language models, mapping them onto the levels of Bloom’s taxonomy to gauge cognitive depth. The study highlights both the strengths and gaps in current models’ problem‑solving abilities, offering a new framework for evaluating AI reasoning.
title: Researchers Apply Bloom’s Taxonomy to Profile Reasoning in Large Language Models
